content_sections.heading: SHSB Specialist Doctor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: SHSB has announced 450 vacancies in total for Specialist Doctors, distributed across six specialties. Candidates should note that the number of vacancies is subject to change based on roster approval and departmental requirement, as stated in the official notification. Category-wise (UR, EWS, SC, ST, EBC, BC, WBC) horizontal and vertical reservation breakup for each post is provided in Annexure-1 of the official notification, along with the district-wise vacancy distribution.

content_sections.heading: SHSB Specialist Doctor Eligibility
content_sections.text: Eligibility for SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026 depends on the specific post applied for. In general, candidates need an MBBS degree along with a postgraduate qualification (MD/MS/DNB) or a Diploma in the relevant specialty, along with valid medical council registration. For all posts, the qualifying degree/diploma must be from a recognized Institute/University, and candidates must be registered (or eligible for registration) with the Bihar Council of Medical Registration (BCMR), Patna , the Medical Council of India (MCI) , or the National Medical Commission (NMC) before joining. Candidates without existing BCMR registration may apply but must submit an affidavit undertaking to obtain registration before joining, failing which their candidature may be cancelled. The cut-off date for determining age, qualification and experience is 1 August 2026 .

rows.minimum_qualification: MD/MS/DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, or DGO
MD/DNB in Paediatrics, or Diploma in Child Health (DCH)
MD/DNB in Anaesthesia, or Diploma in Anaesthesia (DA)
MBBS with MS-Ortho/DNB in Orthopaedic, MD in Orthopaedic, or D.Ortho

content_sections.heading: SHSB Specialist Doctor Age Limit
content_sections.text: As per the official notification, the minimum age for SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026 is 21 years , and the maximum age limit is calculated as on 1 August 2026 , varying by reservation category as shown below. Age relaxation: Persons with disabilities (PwD/Divyang): 10 years relaxation, as per Bihar General Administration Department Resolution No. 962 dated 22.01.2021. Departmental (in-service) candidates of SHSB: 5 years relaxation, subject to fulfilling the minimum eligibility, as per SHSB's Human Resource Rules, 2021. Only one of the above two relaxations is admissible to any single candidate; both cannot be combined. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: SHSB Specialist Doctor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026 is based on a merit list prepared out of 100 total marks , calculated as follows: Additional selection notes: If a candidate's MBBS result was awarded in grade/CGPA, the university/institute-converted percentage will be used; otherwise the candidate is deemed to have secured 50% (the minimum qualifying percentage) as a flat rate. For candidates from foreign medical institutes, marks are computed from the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) score multiplied by 0.6, and registration with MCI/NMC is mandatory. Tie-breaking: If two or more candidates score equal marks, the older candidate (by date of birth) is ranked higher. If age is also equal, higher educational qualification is considered. If a tie still persists, seniority is decided alphabetically based on the candidate's name as recorded in the Class 10 certificate. Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification/Counselling , tentatively scheduled for September 2026 . The final merit list, category-wise and post-wise, will be prepared after successful document verification, in accordance with prevailing Bihar reservation rules. No TA/DA is admissible for document verification or counselling.

faq.question: Q1. What is SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in recruitment drive by the State Health Society, Bihar (SHSB) under Advertisement No. 03/2026 to fill 450 contractual Specialist Doctor posts under the National Health Mission.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 450 vacancies are available across six posts: Obstetrician and Gynaecologist (94), Paediatrician (115), Anaesthetist (132), MD Medicine/Physician (60), General Surgeon (27), and Orthopaedic Surgeon (22).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 21 August 2026, up to 6:00 PM. Applications open on 7 August 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SHSB Specialist Doctor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS with a relevant postgraduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) or Diploma in the specific specialty, recognized by an approved institute/university, along with registration/eligibility for registration with BCMR Patna, MCI, or NMC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years, and the maximum age (as on 1 August 2026) ranges from 37 to 42 years depending on category, with additional relaxation available for PwD and departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee details are not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SHSB Specialist Doctor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through shs.bihar.gov.in under the "Human Resource > Advertisement" section before the closing date.
